column11: owner's ruling of 2026-11-26 on #133 at https://github.com/l3a0/ithildin-runtime/issues/133#issuecomment-7199939899. Schwab's Trader API Market Data Production specification at https://developer.schwab.com/products/trader-api--individual/details/specifications/Market%20Data%20Production read on 2026-11-26 behind the owner's developer sign-in. Its QuoteEquity schema calls bidPrice and askPrice the current best bid and ask price and totalVolume the shares traded through the day including pre-market and post-market hours. It gives lastPrice no description. It calls securityStatus the status of the security with Normal as its example and gives no list of its values where other fields of the page give one. All 92 quotes read in an exploratory count on 2026-11-26 read Normal. They are 24 of GLD and USO from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-25 and 68 of SPY and QQQ from 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-30. marketlake's committed test recording of Schwab's answer reads Normal too. The page gives each side a MIC code of its venue and each answer a quoteType of NBBO or NFL. marketlake's published quote columns carry neither so the venues are unstated

Its QuoteEquity schema calls closePrice the previous day's closing price as PR 219's notes at https://github.com/l3a0/ithildin-runtime/pull/219 record. marketlake's journal maps closePrice to close_price. In an exploratory count from the laptop's copy of the lake it equalled the stored close of the session before on 42 of 44 ticker-days of SPY and QQQ from 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-13 and was lower by the dividend on the other 2. That is the figure exchanges publish so a day's net change reads correctly so on an ex-date it is the close less the dividend. Whether Schwab restates it on a split's own session is unmeasured
